scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a rectangular sketch on the XY plane used by one extrusion
the sketch references the center point
the user chooses Relationships from the sketch row context menu
the Relationships dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item
its Parents list contains the XY plane and center point
its Children list contains the extrusion
the user selects the XY plane in the Parents list
the XY plane row is highlighted in the model browser
the plane is highlighted in the viewport
the user selects the extrusion in the Children list
the extrusion row and its solid edges are highlighted
the user activates the navigation control beside the extrusion
the dialog identifies the extrusion as the selected item
its Parents list contains the XY plane and the sketch
its Children list is empty
the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch in the Parents list
the dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item again
its Children list contains the extrusion
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes
